conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: suspended ordinary short-visitor route with grandfathered VCLs
conflicts.explanation: Taiwan's current Ministry says Morocco suspended VCL applications, Taiwan was ineligible for Moroccan eVisa, and pre-suspension VCLs remain valid; no current passport-wide status is available.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: contradictory required-visa and exempt listings with third-country-document exception
conflicts.explanation: Moldova's MFA simultaneously lists the Dominican Republic in visa-required and visa-exempt material; the required-list exception depends on EU, Schengen, UK, US or Canadian documents.

unresolved.reason: No current Moroccan or Monegasque primary source directly maps an ordinary Monaco passport to exemption, electronic, advance or border issuance. Selector omission is not a complement.

Taiwan's official Ministry says Morocco suspended the former ordinary Taiwanese VCL route and Taiwan is ineligible for Moroccan eVisa, while pre-suspension VCLs remain valid. No current passport-wide visitor status is established.
No current Moroccan or Timor-Leste primary source directly maps an ordinary Timor-Leste passport to an available short-visitor route. Selector omission is not a complement.
No current Moroccan or Kosovo primary source directly maps an ordinary Kosovo passport to an available short-visitor route. Recognition and third-country-document conditions are not transferred.
The current French West Indies component schedules waive only biometric Ukrainian passports. Aggregate FW plus ordinary-passport scope cannot establish that document attribute.
The current French West Indies component schedules restrict Serbia's waiver to biometric passports and exclude Coordination Directorate passports. No uniform ordinary-passport baseline exists.

Guadeloupe and Martinique waive ordinary Ecuadorian passports, but Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy limit Ecuador to diplomatic or service passports. Aggregate FW has no one ordinary-passport result.
The French West Indies component schedules limit Vanuatu's ordinary-passport waiver to documents issued before 25 May 2015. The aggregate ordinary-passport scope has no current uniform baseline.
Dominica is not directly named in Moldova's current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct passport-authority route or issuance timing is established.
Taiwan is not directly named in Moldova's current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct passport-authority route or issuance timing is established.
Kosovo is not directly named in Moldova's current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct passport-authority route or issuance timing is established.

Moldova MFA lists the Dominican Republic in both required-visa and visa-exempt material; the required-list exception depends on third-country visa or residence documents. No passport-only baseline is established.
Türkiye's MFA splits ordinary Algerian visitors among age-based visa exemption, visa-required and qualifying-document-conditioned eVisa cohorts. No passport-wide status is normalized.
Türkiye's MFA makes Egyptian eVisa availability age- and condition-dependent and states an ordinary-passport visa baseline. No passport-wide status is normalized.
Türkiye's MFA splits ordinary Libyan visitors among age-based visa exemption, visa-required and qualifying-document-conditioned eVisa cohorts. No passport-wide status is normalized.
Türkiye's MFA splits ordinary Iraqi visitors among age-based visa exemption, visa-required and qualifying-document-conditioned eVisa cohorts. No passport-wide status is normalized.
